purpose: Teach: 日差し/柔らかく/一度に/親しい/半日/体温/倒れる/別れる

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 夏の日差し、肌に響くね。
lines.en: Summer heat really does hit your skin, doesn't it.
lines.style: Observational, light. No performance. States a shared sensation like she's noticing it aloud. Warm but matter-of-fact. The ease of being with someone who doesn't need you to perform.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。柔らかくマシュマロ、お弁当に入ってた。
lines.en: Yeah. Like the soft marshmallows my mom packed in my bento.
lines.style: Small, genuine smile in the voice. Not trying to impress. A quiet association — connecting her observation to something small and real. Unfussy delivery, like he's thinking as he speaks.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 課題、一度にやろうとすると、しんどい。
lines.en: Trying to power through all my assignments at once just wears you down.
lines.style: Wry but not unkind. A slight exhale on the admission. She's letting the tiredness show, testing whether he'll match it or judge. Not complaining for pity, just being honest. Pace is steady but underneath there's fatigue.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 親しい友達、減ったり増えたり、変わるよな。
lines.en: Your close friends change though, don't they. People come and go.
lines.style: Quiet, turning something over in his head. Not heavy — just genuine observation. Slight hesitation, like he's checking if it's okay to say this. Slower pace. Not seeking agreement, just thinking aloud in her presence.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: The cram school half-day left me pretty worn out.
lines.style: Subdued, controlled. She's tired and letting it show without making it a performance. Quiet underneath — not seeking comfort, just stating fact. A small exhale at the end like she's releasing something she was holding.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 体温、夏でも微妙に上下する。
lines.en: Even in summer, your body temperature keeps shifting, doesn't it.
lines.style: Casual observation. Not trying to fix anything. He's noticing small physical truths and sharing them — the way he notices things. Steady pace. Gentle and accepting of how bodies just work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 部活で、後輩が、倒れる寸前で、心配だった。
lines.en: One of the junior members at club almost collapsed today. I was really worried.
lines.style: Softly protective. Real concern beneath the surface. Not dramatizing, but you can hear she cares. Slight vulnerability on 'really worried' — she's let something genuine show. A moment of her caring more than she usually lets people see.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 駅で別れる前に、コンビニ寄ろう。
lines.en: Before we split at the station, we should stop by the convenience store.
lines.style: Natural pivot to something practical and together. Not heavy — just suggesting a small shared moment before goodbye. Warmth without sentimentality. The ease of someone comfortable in togetherness, offering an extra few minutes.
